contracts: Only segmented journals; reject events.jsonl before creating journal/. No compatibility reader or migration.

Immutable logical views share append-only chunked metadata with captured entry counts and cached boundary prefix hashes. Rotation does not copy earlier entries; historical prefix capture does not copy or fold the prior catalog.

Runtime-owned descriptor-rooted JournalReads publishes after successful fsync before fanout, independently of the append mutex. Eight admitted views per host; leases survive blocking-task cancellation.
Fallible subscription capture occurs after installing its live receiver. One bounded replay page, exact cursor validation, lag recovery, and no whole-gap attach rebroadcast.
Fork copying uses bounded pages and resumes only an identical partial child.
rw sessions verify performs a full typed event integrity scan, including session, sequence and protocol identity; normal tail pages do not verify unread historical payloads.
